# Filter rows where Runner Up is "Philadelphia Eagles" (they were NFC champions when they were the runner-up)
eagles_champions = df[df['Runner Up'].str.lower() == 'philadelphia eagles']

# Get the leading rusher from the row(s) where Philadelphia Eagles were NFC champions
# Since the question says "the only time they were NFC champions", we expect exactly one row
if not eagles_champions.empty:
    leading_rusher = eagles_champions['Leading Rusher'].iloc[0]
    answer = leading_rusher
else:
    answer = None
